limits: This helper validates finalized evaluator receipts, not arbitrary externally supplied runtime claims. Its validity flags are not authenticated evidence outside that caller contract.
The policy is post-measurement regression acceptance, not blind validation or proof of linguistic completeness.
A successful partial-coverage gate leaves strict_pass false, all six construction cases failed, and the reported coverage at80/86.
Zero false accepts applies only to the declared finite forbidden-claim and safety checks.
logic_findings: The new policy is selected only for the pinned v2 runtime. The helper additionally checks snapshot digest/count and gold/source pins; historical evaluator branches remain separate.

Ordered case and check inventories, Boolean check/pass markers, integer totals, case failure/check agreement and raw identities prevent deletion, duplication, reordering and bool/int substitution from hiding coverage debt.

Failures are admitted only by exact payload equality. A newly failing check, a restored fixed check inside an existing residual case, a changed question status or a changed certificate is not covered by the policy.
Per-case and aggregate false accepts, replay failures, execution errors, finalization failures and question certificate failure are not waived.
Shrinking debt is permitted, while each remaining failure must retain its reviewed payload. The helper does not alter scores, checks or strict_pass.

Caller inspection confirms source/runtime checks and byte-bound raw finalization run before gate_decision. Construction finalization compares raw score payloads with result cases; discourse journal verification receives the final case list.
Helper/policy/test files are included in both measured snapshots and source archives; later edits are visible in provenance.
review_scope: Read-only policy and code/test review. The artifact comparison below was executed; the test suite and runtime/evaluators were not rerun by this reviewer.
